name: Unleash Node.js SDK
solves: Provides the official Node.js client (`unleash-client`) for the Unleash feature management platform, evaluating flags server-side with streaming or polling updates, activation strategies, and constraints against a self-hosted or Unleash-hosted control plane.
best_for: Node backends that evaluate Unleash flags server-side with the official SDK
Organizations running Unleash (self-hosted or Unleash Cloud) that need a maintained Node client
Services that need activation strategies and context constraints without embedding a full flag UI
Platform teams standardizing on Unleash across languages via official SDKs
Migrations off homemade toggle tables toward Unleash-backed evaluation
skip_when: You want flags bundled with product analytics (PostHog) rather than a dedicated feature-management tool
You need to self-host the Unleash server and AGPL-3.0 is incompatible — use Unleash Cloud/Enterprise or another vendor
You only need a vendor-neutral API and have not chosen an Unleash backend — start with OpenFeature plus a provider
A tiny boolean config in env vars is enough
You prefer GrowthBook's experimentation-first workflow over Unleash's FM model

hosted_alternative.name: Unleash Cloud
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Node SDK is Apache-2.0; Unleash server self-host is AGPL-3.0. Unleash Cloud/Enterprise plans are commercial
